composition_subtypes.role: Select top b by hp-dmg gain; optionally swap one for max-boosted creature.

payload.core_composition_summary: Greedy selection based on sorted hp-dmg differences to apply type-2 spells, with a special case for concentrating type-1 spells on one creature.
payload.rationale: The solution is fundamentally a single greedy mechanism with sorting as a preprocessing step, not a combination of distinct algorithmic families.
